sources.title: VedaVachan/kcat-km-v18 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The external table contains labels for 1,104 of the 1,901 val_inputs pairs (58.1%): 911 kcat and 1,083 Km. The model is trained normally: there is no lookup of val_inputs pairs, no hard-coding and no exact-pair feature.

sources.title: "CatPred: A Deep Learning Breakthrough for Enzyme Kinetics"
sources.snippet: CatPred changes the game by bringing deep probabilistic learning into the mix -> predicting kcat, Km, and Ki with high accuracy and uncertainty quantification to guide predictions with confidence ...
